title: A PR create (GitHub MCP or the merge tool) whose base is `stable` is refused at create
why: Consultant 01:07 CST Nov 14 (relayed; unchecked by triage): PR #3349 was opened with base `stable`, so the merge tool refused it at merge time (runner 10, 01:05) and it lost an hour. Also named by the consultant: about 80 open drafts stack on lane branches whose bases may be merged or gone; the coordinator sorts those (not part of this step).
source: Consultant 01:07 CST Nov 14 (relayed). Neighbours: lane-lint-stack-holds-base (ready: a stacked PR head holds its base), delete-refused-while-pr-base (todo), stacked-head-keeps-go (todo). A stacked lane PR legitimately has a lane branch as base; this step refuses only base `stable`.
note: Triage 01:10 CST Nov 14: the mistake the guard would stop: a lane opening a PR against the stable branch instead of main. The harm: the PR is refused at merge, an hour lost. Fix: red first: a create-PR call (GitHub MCP `create_pull_request`, merge tool create) with base `stable` is refused, with a printed remedy that names the right base without naming the forbidden one; controls: base `main` and a stacked lane base pass. The lane first reads why the merge tool refused a `stable` base (the record, not the relay) and says whether the right base is main in every repo. A guard change: own lane, review rounds apply. Not started. Second guard point 01:42 CST Nov 14 (runner 10 via its own message 01:40, relayed; its log ready3349.log unread by triage): `merge <pr> --ready` passed on #3349 (switch-decisions-degen-home, base `stable`) at 00:01 CST; CI ran against the stable base (30 of 30 green); only `merge 3349 --confirm` refused at 00:54 CST ("stable has no branch protection and no ruleset that requires checks"). Cost per the runner: about 40 min of CI on the wrong base plus a retarget and a new CI run. So the step covers two points: refuse at create AND refuse at `merge <pr> --ready` when REST base.ref is not main (or a lane branch for a stacked PR). Red first: `--ready` on a PR with base `stable` refuses; base `main` and a stacked lane base pass. The runner named this guard under rule building-mistake-names-its-guard; this step is its home.
